points.quote: Follow assessment instructions around permitted AI use and disclosure
points.gist: Follow assessment instructions about permitted AI use and disclosure.

points.quote: Apply institutional accepted referencing standards for AI tools, including in-text citations, reference lists, and university declaration statements.
points.gist: Apply the institution's accepted referencing standards for AI tools, including in-text citations, reference lists and university declaration statements.

points.quote: Apply appropriate referencing techniques to acknowledge the use of AI generated content in academic work, including accurate use of in-text citations in line with institutional academic integrity guidelines.
points.gist: Use appropriate referencing, including accurate in-text citations, to acknowledge AI-generated content in academic work.

points.quote: Critically assess the limitations of generative AI outputs by identifying potential biases and inaccuracies, and edit the content using informed judgement before incorporating it into academic work.
points.anchor: Using AI through a Critical Lens
points.gist: Assess generative AI outputs for limitations, biases and inaccuracies, and edit the content with informed judgement before using it in academic work.

points.quote: Apply University policies on data protection, privacy, and academic integrity when selecting and using approved academic work, ensuring responsible and ethical practice.
points.anchor: Legal, Regulatory and Policy Awareness and Compliance
points.gist: Apply University policies on data protection, privacy and academic integrity when selecting and using approved academic work.

points.quote: Recognise the risks of over-reliance on AI including the devaluation of learning opportunities at University
points.gist: Recognise the risks of over-relying on AI, including devaluing learning opportunities at University.

points.quote: Identify and use criteria for evaluating the accuracy of AI output and address any issues identified.
points.anchor: Using AI through a Critical Lens
points.gist: Identify and use criteria for evaluating the accuracy of AI output and address any issues found.

points.quote: The policy outlines the guidelines and principles for the responsible use of Artificial Intelligence (AI) applications, including generative AI, in assessment at Swansea University.
points.gist: A Swansea policy outlines guidelines and principles for responsible use of AI, including generative AI, in assessment.

points.quote: Use AI tools to develop and use study resources including summaries, key points for revision and self-assessments.
points.gist: Use AI tools to develop and use study resources such as summaries, revision key points and self-assessments.

points.quote: Consistently acknowledge and reflect upon AI use in academic contexts, even where not specifically required.
points.gist: Consistently acknowledge and reflect on AI use in academic contexts, even where this is not specifically required.

points.quote: The Centre for Academic Success runs regular workshops including AI Literacy.
points.gist: The Centre for Academic Success runs regular workshops, including AI Literacy.

points.quote: A short course (approx. 50 mins) aimed at students to help you learn the basic functions of AI
points.gist: Microsoft Learn offers a short course of about 50 minutes for students on the basic functions of AI.

points.quote: The Academic Integrity Ambassadors (AIAs) are a team of volunteer students whose aim is to promote a culture of Academic Integrity across the university in a way that will resonate with other students.
points.gist: Academic Integrity Ambassadors are volunteer students who promote a culture of academic integrity in a way that resonates with other students.
